mapper.select:
select DISTINCT(ur.`id`), ur.`name`, ur.`email`, ur.`phone`, ur.`mobile`, ur.`avatar`, ur.`gender`, ur.`remark`, ur.`username`, ur.`password`, ur.`admin`, ur.`enabled`, ur.`entry_date`, ur.`last_login_time`, ur.`last_login_address`, ur.`last_update_password_time`, ur.`extension`, ur.`deleted`, ur.`create_by`, ur.`create_time`, ur.`update_by`, ur.`update_time`, ur.`validity`, ut.`work_status`, ur.`id_card`, ur.`photograph_key` from `user` ur inner join `user_tenant` ut on ut.`user_id` = ur.`id`
inner join `user_organization` uorg on uorg.`user_id` = ur.`id`
ut.`tenant` = #{tenant} AND (ut.`belong_tenant` IS NULL OR ut.`belong_tenant` != 'NOT_BELONG') AND ur.`enabled` = true
and (ut.`enabled` = #{param.enabled} or ut.`enabled` is null)
and ut.`enabled` = #{param.enabled}
and ur.`id` in
#{id}
and uorg.`organization_id` in ( select `id` from `organization` org inner join ( select sequence from `organization` org where `id` = #{param.organizationId} ) t on org.`sequence` like concat(t.sequence, '%') )
and (ur.`name` like concat('%', #{param.keyword}, '%') or ur.`mobile` like concat('%', #{param.keyword}, '%'))
and ut.`work_status` = #{param.workStatus}
and ur.`id` not in
#{id}
order by
CASE WHEN EXISTS ( select 1 from `user_organization` sort_uorg where sort_uorg.`user_id` = ur.`id` and sort_uorg.`organization_id` = #{param.sortId} ) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC,
(CASE WHEN ut.`work_status` ='WORKING' THEN 1 WHEN ut.`work_status` ='LEAVE_POST' THEN 2 WHEN ut.`work_status` ='ASK_LEAVE' THEN 3 WHEN ut.`work_status` ='REST' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END) ASC ,`create_time` DESC
